'''Tampereen Ilves''' ({{IPA|fi|ˈilʋes|pron}}; [[Finnish language|Finnish]] for "[[Eurasian lynx|Lynx]]"; {{langx|sv|Ilves Tammerfors}}), commonly known as '''Ilves''', is a Finnish professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Tampere]]. They currently play in the [[Veikkausliiga]], the highest level of professional football in Finland."}}
